claim_boundary: Mechanism extraction from primary sources only; not a win/loss table.
coverage_note: Not every system×row cell is densely filled; empty cells are CANNOT_CHECK pending deeper code audit, not silent equivalence.

multi_agent_delegation.actual_competitor_mechanism: Phased laboratory agents with human researcher in loop
multi_agent_delegation.hypothesized_advantage_disadvantage: Fairness: human time must be cost-accounted
multi_agent_delegation.material_difference: Agent Lab assumes human assistance; RAKL human gates are explicit BLOCKED_HUMAN
multi_agent_delegation.rakl_analogue: multi-role expert cell (same-context) + human gates where required

planning_search_algorithm.hypothesized_advantage_disadvantage: Do not compare SaaS Novix to open commit

experiment_code_execution.distinguishing_experiment: Outcome peek before freeze — RAKL must block
experiment_code_execution.material_difference: AI Scientist-v2 optimizes discovery throughput; RAKL freezes evaluators first

planning_search_algorithm.actual_competitor_mechanism: Agentic tree search over research trajectories
planning_search_algorithm.distinguishing_experiment: Same ideation budget; compare recovery from failed branch
planning_search_algorithm.material_difference: Tree search explores experiment variants; RAKL searches transformations with exhaustion witnesses

claim_to_result_checking.actual_competitor_mechanism: integrity verification + result-to-claim mapping + claim audit
claim_to_result_checking.material_difference: Both map claims to evidence; ARIS is manuscript-centric harness

review_adversarial_critique.distinguishing_experiment: Single-family self-review vs cross-family on identical claim ledger
review_adversarial_critique.hypothesized_advantage_disadvantage: ARIS strong on plausible-unsupported-success; RAKL strong on typed authority
review_adversarial_critique.material_difference: ARIS operationalizes cross-model adversarial review by default

scientific_authority_semantics.actual_competitor_mechanism: Reviewer approval gates harness self-improvement; not theorem authority calculus
scientific_authority_semantics.distinguishing_experiment: Ask each system to mint theorem authority from review score
scientific_authority_semantics.hypothesized_advantage_disadvantage: Do not equate review pass with theorem authority
scientific_authority_semantics.material_difference: ARIS assurance ≠ RAKL scientific authority types

memory_representation.actual_competitor_mechanism: SciMem schema-governed LT knowledge + active research memory / wiki
memory_representation.hypothesized_advantage_disadvantage: AutoSci may retain richer project artifacts; RAKL stronger on authority separation
memory_representation.material_difference: AutoSci emphasizes wiki/lifecycle memory; RAKL separates proposal/shadow vs canonical admission

negative_history_semantics.actual_competitor_mechanism: Failed directions retained in memory modules (paper)
negative_history_semantics.distinguishing_experiment: Plant failed hypothesis and measure re-proposal rate
negative_history_semantics.material_difference: Need code-level check that nulls are first-class vs soft-forgotten

self_evolution_promotion_gate.distinguishing_experiment: Attempt promotion with exposed assurance packet — RAKL must refuse
self_evolution_promotion_gate.hypothesized_advantage_disadvantage: RAKL stricter promotion; AutoSci faster iteration risk
self_evolution_promotion_gate.material_difference: AutoSci evolution is harness/skill update; RAKL forbids same-session promotion as assurance
self_evolution_promotion_gate.rakl_analogue: Self-RAKL / evolution archive with fresh assurance

failure_retention.actual_competitor_mechanism: IVE classifies implementation vs fundamental failure
failure_retention.material_difference: Both keep failures; RAKL requires typed relations and scope

memory_representation.actual_competitor_mechanism: Ideation Memory M_I + Experimentation Memory M_E
memory_representation.distinguishing_experiment: Reuse after close failure without DifferenceWitness
memory_representation.material_difference: EvoScientist stores strategies/failures for reuse; RAKL binds authority levels

self_evolution_proposal.actual_competitor_mechanism: EMA distills interaction histories into reusable knowledge
self_evolution_proposal.hypothesized_advantage_disadvantage: Evo may over-promote; RAKL may under-adapt
self_evolution_proposal.material_difference: EvoScientist continuous memory update; RAKL Class B/C gates

provenance_reproducibility.hypothesized_advantage_disadvantage: Use as shared substrate when task-compatible
provenance_reproducibility.material_difference: Arena is not a researcher agent competitor
provenance_reproducibility.rakl_analogue: RAKL benchmarks freeze packets before outcomes
